annotations.title: Answer buyer questions: security, LGPD, apps, migration, support

description: Answers from the All4Clinic website for the questions a clinic asks before buying: LGPD and data security, permissions and audit trail, several units and professionals, mobile and Windows apps, digital signature validity, how patients pay, what the AI does and does not do, migrating from another system and support. Optional query filters the answers (Portuguese or English keywords); without it returns all of them. For how-to steps inside the product use search_help.

query.description: Optional keywords, e.g. "LGPD", "aplicativo", "migrar", "suporte", "unidades". Empty returns every answer.
